text: The Training and Development Consultant, Confronting Anti-Black Racism Unit, Social Development, Finance and Administration Division, will give a presentation on Training Session on Anti-Black Racism: Part 2. The Board of Health will meet in closed session on this item in accordance with the provisions of the City of Toronto Act, 2006 which permits the closing of a meeting for the education or training of the Directors.
The Board of Health: 1. Directed that Confidential Attachment 1 remain confidential in its entirety, as it pertains to the education or training of the Directors.
